type: sudo apt-get update -qq; sudo apt-get install -y -qq strace 2>&1 | tail -1

sudo sh -c 'P=/dev/virtio-ports/hscl.qa; L(){ echo "Q68| $*" >$P; }; L env; env|grep -E "^(QT_|XDG_)"|sort >$P 2>&1; for i in $(seq 1 6); do strace -f -qq -o /tmp/s.$i -e trace=write timeout 16 /usr/bin/calamares-launch-normal >/tmp/o.$i 2>&1; rc=$?; L "S $i rc=$rc"; if [ $rc -ne 124 ]; then L "== app tail $i =="; tail -18 /tmp/o.$i >$P; L "== strace tail $i =="; tail -25 /tmp/s.$i >$P; fi; sleep 2; done; L end'
